page_title: TOT 1-2 AST | Tottenham Hotspur v Aston Villa 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' A wild effort from Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
90+6' The corner from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez.
90+5' The corner is flicked onto Emerson Royal (Tottenham), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the right post.
90+5' Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+3' Poor challenge! Pau Torres (Aston Villa) is penalised for tripping and Robert Jones blows his whistle.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ollie Watkins as he is replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
90+1' Here is a change. John McGinn is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa).
90+1' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to send in a decent cross from the free kick from the edge of the box. His effort goes out of play.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul after Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) hacks down one of his opponents.
89' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
89' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
87' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
87' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
86' Substitution. Alejo Veliz (Tottenham) on for Giovani Lo Celso.
85' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
85' Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
83' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
82' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) goes into the referee's book for dissent.

82' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Guglielmo Vicario sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
80' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
80' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
80' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
79' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
77' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) tries to find Oliver Skipp, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
77' The attendance for today's match is 61679.
77' A lofted cross from Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
76' The ball is cleared after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
75' A great solo run by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the top of the net was easily caught by Emiliano Martinez.
74' The resulting corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

73' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
72' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
71' Substitution. Bryan Gil walks off the pitch and Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) comes on as a substitute.

71' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
71' The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
70' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but Guglielmo Vicario dives superbly to deny him. His shot went towards the top right corner.
69' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ollie Watkins, but Guglielmo Vicario displays great awareness to stop him.
68' Ben Davies (Tottenham) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just over the bar.
68' Tottenham will take a corner kick.
68' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez was alert and made an astonishing save!
67' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Tottenham as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

67' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Tottenham.
65' It could have been a good chance to score! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to release Dejan Kulusevski with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
64' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
64' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
63' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Robert Jones blows his whistle for an infringement.
61' 1 - 2 Goal! Youri Tielemans slips it to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 1:2.
61' John McGinn (Aston Villa) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.
60' Guglielmo Vicario is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Diego Carlos (Aston Villa). Easy save!
60' Robert Jones blows his whistle and signals a foul after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) brought his opponent down.
59' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
59' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
58' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robert Jones blows for a foul.
58' The ball is cleared after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
56' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Emiliano Martinez.
56' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
55' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) tries to find Brennan Johnson, but he puts too much power on the pass.
54' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
53' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

52' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
52' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
51' A pass by Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
50' What an opportunity! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
50' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
49' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) will take a free kick in a very promising position.
47' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
47' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is penalised for holding. Robert Jones signals a set piece.
47' Robert Jones blows his whistle after Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
46' Unai Emery has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Youri Tielemans comes on the pitch for Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Matty Cash (Aston Villa) comes off for Leon Bailey.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+10' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+9' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Aston Villa players have a reason to celebrate!
45+9' The Aston Villa players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

45+7' 1 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Douglas Luiz sends a cross in and Pau Torres (Aston Villa) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes inside the right post and he makes it 1:1.
45+7' A clumsy foul by Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) and Robert Jones blows his whistle.
45+5' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+4' Robert Jones blows his whistle after Matty Cash (Aston Villa) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
45+2' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Diego Carlos (Aston Villa). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
43' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
43' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' A pass from Bryan Gil (Tottenham) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez and the move breaks down.
41' The referee gives a yellow card to John McGinn (Aston Villa) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
41' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Jones blows for a foul.
38' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
37' An attempted cross from Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is cleared.
36' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
35' The ball spins to Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
32' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) is substituted due to injury. Ange Postecoglou gives a chance to Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg.
31' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) picks up an injury.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Aston Villa players look gutted.
25' Wait! Referee Robert Jones has indicated he is going to review the Aston Villa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
24' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finds the back of the net with a superb finish!

22' 1 - 0 The ball bounced beyond the penalty box from the corner kick. Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) was standing in the right place at the right time. He unleashed a brilliant shot past the helpless goalkeeper and his attempt ended up in the top of the net.
22' Corner kick. Tottenham will have an opportunity.
22' A quickly taken corner by Tottenham.

21' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Tottenham force a corner. They send men into the box.
19' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
18' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
15' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
14' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) trips an opposition player and Robert Jones signals a foul.
13' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
13' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
12' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
12' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) jumps into a tackle and Robert Jones signals a foul.
8' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) gets to the rebound but blows his chance to score with a header from a dangerous position inside the box. His effort floats high over the bar.
8' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
6' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will take a throw-in.

6' What a chance that is! Pau Torres (Aston Villa) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post.
5' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) will take a long-range free kick and all of his teammates who are good in the air are already waiting on the edge of the penalty box for a cross to be sent in to them.

4' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.

4' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the left post and ricochets away.
3' A short pass finds Destiny Udogie (Tottenham). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
1' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Aston Villa will kick the game off.
Robert Jones will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
